Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::createBankCard(cardid: Integer,cardstatus: CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog: CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password: Integer,balance: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		foundCards: Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(b|b.CardID = cardid),
		success: Boolean = true
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		cardstatus.oclIsTypeOf(CardStatus) and
		catalog.oclIsTypeOf(CardCatalog) and
		password.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		balance.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(o: BankCard|o.CardID)
	postcondition:
		if foundCards.isEmpty() = true 
		then let newBankCard: BankCard in
		newBankCard.oclIsNew() and
		BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newBankCard) and
		newBankCard.CardID = cardid and
		newBankCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		newBankCard.Catalog = catalog and
		newBankCard.Password = password and
		newBankCard.Balance = balance and
		result = success 
		else result = success 
		endif 
}
